meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 装上后,遇到前端/界面/视觉任务,Claude 会先加载对应规则集;写组件前必须建立 DESIGN.md 设计系统,完成后用真实浏览器做视觉 QA 和 Lighthouse 审计,产出可复用组件而非一次性截图。
howto.when: 当用户请求前端/界面/视觉工作,如提到 UI、UX、design 等关键词,或要求重设计、动效、性能审计、品牌风格时触发。

say.text: 帮我重设计这个页面,让它更高级,参考 Stripe 的风格。
say.note: 会加载品牌参考和设计规则,先产出 DESIGN.md。

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 审计当前 React 应用,目标是每项 100 分。
say.note: 会用 Playwright 跑真实浏览器审计。

say.text: 查一下适合这个产品的配色和字体搭配。
say.note: 调用 ui-ux-db 查询设计系统。

howto.what_en: When a frontend/UI/visual task arrives, Claude first routes to the relevant ruleset, insists on or creates a DESIGN.md before writing components, then runs real-browser visual QA and Lighthouse audits, producing reusable primitives rather than one-off screens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests frontend/UI/UX/visual work, e.g. mentions UI, UX, design, or asks for redesign, motion, performance audits, or a brand-like look.

say_en.text: Redesign this page to look more premium, referencing Stripe's style.
say_en.note: Loads brand reference and design rules, produces DESIGN.md first.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on the current React app targeting 100 in every category.
say_en.note: Uses Playwright with a real browser.

say_en.text: Look up color palettes and font pairings for this product.
